note: Total execution state machine, review/loop-budget vocabulary and portability classification cases. Declared sets are literal and closed (D51/D65); the 9x15 matrix is total by construction; every set this document REFERENCES rather than owns names its owner and its file:line source (D64). Consumers: AGENT-RELIABILITY P2.2-P2.5, 2026.07.18-FOREMAN P2/P5, 2026.07.25-ECO-OPT P9 (D66).

new_reason_codes.fires_when: an observed (state, event) cell is missing, duplicated, or its guard branches do not partition the guard's declared value set
new_reason_codes.justification: SLICE_INCOMPLETE grades the partition of the eleven CONTRACT KEYS between root and subagent; this code grades the partition of the execution LIFECYCLE matrix. Neither can fire for the other's object.

new_reason_codes.fires_when: a state projects to no canonical status, a canonical status is reached by no state, a journal RESULT_VALUE is reached by no transition, or a declared decision output is produced by no transition
new_reason_codes.justification: EVIDENCE_REF_UNKNOWN fires when an acceptance entry points at an undeclared evidence id — a dangling reference inside one contract. This code fires on a dead END of a declared projection, i.e. a vocabulary the machine can never produce.

new_reason_codes.fires_when: finding_id is derived from anything but the defect's seam (file/rule/contract locus), so a cosmetic re-split changes the id
new_reason_codes.justification: LOOP_BUDGET_EXCEEDED fires on the COUNT of observed rounds against a declared budget. This code fires on the identity function that makes the count meaningful: with an unstable id the budget never trips at all.

new_reason_codes.fires_when: a transition reopens product on a finding that is neither product-typed, nor a security blocker, nor evidence invalidating acceptance
new_reason_codes.justification: NEXT_CHANGED_WITHOUT_TRANSITION guards WHO may author the next step (a diagnostic may not). This code guards WHAT may reopen a product already proven green — a different object and a different boundary.

new_reason_codes.fires_when: the tier assigned to a piece of work contradicts the declared classification rule, or an execution input is also listed as provenance
new_reason_codes.justification: PORTABILITY_INPUT_MISSING fires on the INPUTS given a tier. This code fires on the assignment of the tier itself: a multi-session/handoff task labelled brief-acceptance passes P0.2's input check vacuously, because an empty input list is legal for that tier.

new_reason_codes.fires_when: the cap-resolution transition is not parameterized by a declared authority profile, or a profile declares no cap subject/source
new_reason_codes.justification: AUTHORITY_BOUNDARY fires when an owner-gate class is not granted — the boundary itself. This code fires when the SUBJECT of a decision at an exhausted cap is hardcoded instead of parameterized, which is a defect even when no boundary is crossed.

new_reason_codes.fires_when: a declared set differs between its marked contract block and this file, is marked in two contracts, is missing a block, or a referenced set is marked as owned
new_reason_codes.justification: VERSION_HASH_MISMATCH grades one contract payload against its own declared hash. This code grades PROSE against DATA across two different artifacts, which no hash of either one can detect.

new_reason_codes.fires_when: a declared positive routine case yields anything other than continue-next, or fewer than the declared minimum of positive cases exist
new_reason_codes.justification: ACCEPTANCE_NOT_PUBLIC refuses a final response that rests only on internal evidence — a false GREEN. This code refuses the opposite failure, a false RED: F14 (`reliability-acceptance-v1.md:89-93`) exists because a maximally conservative machine scores green on every other floor.

projection.note: `project(state, material_deviation) -> status` is a total function. DONE is the ONLY state whose image depends on the attribute, and that is required by D65 itself: 🟢 and 🟠 are not states, they are one state separated by the plan-protocol §6 material predicate, so the attribute must be projection INPUT or D65 could not hold. Every other state has a constant image.

status_notes.OWNER_BOUNDARY: 🟡, not 🔴: plan-protocol §8 reserves 🔴 for a DEFECT (plan diverged from code, needs re-design) and classes a healthy wait on external state as `waiting:`. An ungranted G1 authority is a healthy wait.
status_notes.INCIDENT: 🔴: an exhausted budget is a defect of the loop, and the canonical remediation is a decision plus a re-design, not another repair round.

finding_identity.reopen_of: a finding that re-raises a closed one carries `reopen_of: <finding_id>`; the pair counts as ONE identity against same_finding_max
finding_identity.split_ban: splitting one seam into several reports does not create several identities: the id is recomputed from the seam, so the cap cannot be evaded cosmetically
